outcome: time spent in labor delivery unit
cohort: 182 nulliparous women at a gestational age of 39 0/7 weeks or more with a single live pregnancy and a cervical status of <=5 at 38 0/7 to 38 6/7 weeks.
finding: Elective induction of labor did not increase the risk of cesarean delivery in nulliparous women with unfavorable cervix and did not result in increased adverse maternal or neonatal outcomes.
